meta.title: fix: prevent memory leaks across application
meta.body_summary: Add dispose methods to all manager classes and implement memory leak prevention across the Onlook desktop application.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added dispose methods across managers; no review, merged quickly with bot comment only; no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1976 changed lines across 45 files, this is a medium-to-large refactor by absolute volume. It adds dispose boilerplate across many engine components. The PR was merged without formal review, consistent with a comprehensive but routine cleanup that maintainer accepted quickly.

review_details.performance_claim: Prevent memory leaks across the application by implementing proper dispose methods.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding lifecycle disposal methods across a TypeScript/Electron codebase is a mechanical refactor; merge succeeded without review likely due to trust in the pattern.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body claims tests pass but no performance data; no memory profiling or before/after metrics.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions noted; PR merged without reversions.

core_change_summary.description: Added dispose() methods to multiple manager classes (code, copy, group, insert, move, style, etc.), implemented cleanup in WebviewMessageBridge, and updated EditorEngine to call dispose on each manager. Also added IPC handler cleanup, interval cleanup in preload/webview, and window cleanup in main process, with additional commits from maintainer adjusting processDom calls and file handling.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Many changes in the merge commit and subsequent maintainer commits are unrelated to the memory leak fix; they include new setup UI, file handling adjustments, and debouncing.
change_trajectory: Initial Devin commits: added dispose methods across engine managers and electron cleanup.
Merge from main brought in unrelated UI and infrastructure changes.
Maintainer added debouncing for processDom, file tracking, and cleanup commits, merging the final changes.

review_signals.summary: Devin bot announced automatic comment/CI monitoring assistance.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with comprehensive memory leak fixes; no human review occurred; Devin bot posted introduction; maintainer merged after ~14 hours with additional clean-up commits.
